import os

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])

    pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,5)]
    r0=min(r for r,c,v in pts); c0=min(c for r,c,v in pts)
    template=[(r-r0,c-c0,v) for r,c,v in pts]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]

                for dr,dc,v in template:
                    rr,cc=top+dr,left+dc
                    if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)

                        rr,cc=top+i,left+j

    return out
''')
